description: Collaborative Research: Self-Centering Pendulum Shear Walls in Buildings via Nonlinear Elastic Kinematics is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Pedro Silva, George Washington University (gwu.edu). Project Description This project addresses a critical challenge in structural engineering, which is to develop building systems designed with Lateral Force Resisting Systems that can resist extreme natural hazards, such as hurricanes and earthquakes, with minimal or no damage. The research explores an innovative structural design concept for unbonded, post-tensioned, reinforced concrete shear walls (UPSWs). Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Energy Dissipation, Loading Rate, Friction Coefficient, Pendulum Motion, Structural Resiliency., Unbonded Post-Tensioned Shear Walls. Published 2024-11-17. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
